verdict.rationale: A shared visual whiteboard is a fair question for a team collaboration tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents Trello's kanban boards and cards: a 'visual layout' for tracking tasks and design-team request workflows. Nothing shows a freeform whiteboard canvas for drawing, sketching or spatial ideation. Kanban boards are an adjacent feature and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
